cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline
cp git_gc_weekly.sh git_gc_weekly.sh.bak_20261020
echo  | base64 -d > git_gc_weekly.sh.new && bash -n git_gc_weekly.sh.new && mv git_gc_weekly.sh.new git_gc_weekly.sh && chmod +x git_gc_weekly.sh && echo SCRIPT_OK
crontab -l > /root/crontab.bak_20261020
crontab -l | sed -E 's#^30 4 \* \* 0 timeout 900 (/opt/weather-pipeline/git_gc_weekly.sh)#30 4 * * * timeout 1800 \1#' | crontab -
echo "--- cron gc line:"; crontab -l | grep git_gc; echo "cron lines: $(crontab -l | wc -l) (was $(wc -l < /root/crontab.bak_20261020))"
echo "--- dry run:"; timeout 60 ./git_gc_weekly.sh
echo "--- /opt now:"; du -h --max-depth=1 /opt | sort -rh
echo "--- mtimes:"; stat -c '%y %n' /opt/silero-venv /opt/silero-models /opt/dwd-fronts /opt/trading-bot /opt/unified-monitoring-agent /opt/weather-pipeline/cases | cut -c1-60
echo "--- big in /home:"; du -h --max-depth=2 /home 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -5
echo "--- df:"; df -h / | tail -1
